evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: zenagamtide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: zenagamtide has 4 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Novo Nordisk A/S. Planned enrollment across these trials: 10500 participants. Statuses: NOT_YET_RECRUITING 2, RECRUITING 2. Earliest planned primary completion 2028-06-27, latest 2030-09-16. Trials: NCT07668401, NCT07668414, NCT07720271, NCT07861100. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.
